prerequisites: fetch and compare origin/main before P11
consume SkillVersion and P02/P06 Artifact as immutable Runtime authorities
implement telemetry export only in P11
authorityBoundary: Runtime PostgreSQL owns SkillVersion, exact lifecycle receipts, compiled Artifact, validation, active pointer and Outbox. Control owns only its proxy ManagementOperation and audit. P11 may export telemetry but cannot create a second telemetry query authority or move durable facts into Redis.
